variable_coverage.construction: FERROR=abs(reported annual EPS_{t−1}−median analyst EPS forecast_{t−1}) / stock price at beginning of fiscal year t−1. Forecast median is selected from the six months before fiscal year-end.
NUM is I/B/E/S analyst count for annual EPS forecasts in the month of the firm’s fiscal year-end in t−1.
MVE=ln[(December 31 t−1 share price × shares outstanding × applicable Worldscope FX conversion)/1,000,000]. Natural log is specified; current market input/FX fields and code identity are unverified.
DISCLOSE is the country-of-domicile count across eight specified disclosure areas where domestic GAAP has no/weaker requirement than IAS, based on standards in force 1993-01-01.

review_notes: The paper reports 163 adopters, then excludes Italy (7), South Africa (22), and one Bermuda firm to leave 133; 53 lack needed data and the final sample is 80. Appendix A defines each index component, but a primary historical standards route and firm-level initial roster are still missing.

All local routes remain undetermined for coverage: no coordinator coverage confirmations were supplied. A successful bounded exact-resource probe verifies readability and listed columns only, not the required history, mappings, population or benchmark universe.
